sources.title: Piracy monthly report July 2025
sources.text: While underway, the crew spotted a blue wooden boat alongside port quarter of ship. The master raised the alarm and the crew mustered. Upon hearing the alarm, six perpetrators were observed escaping into the boat. A security search was conducted, with no perpetrators found onboard. The padlocks for the deck store, steering gear room and engine casing were found broken. Few items of ship stores were stolen. The crew was not injured. The incident was reported to Singapore POCC. Safety broadcasts on anti-piracy watch were initiated to warn all vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the SS. The RSN’s MSTF was notified of the incident. Information of the incident was shared with the Indonesian authority.
